mobbin:cc79d322-0fc9-4e2e-ac99-94fc9bee9.summary: In step 1 of 2 of creating an AI app, the author writes an AI prompt, picks at least two meetings, and turns on 'Preview Notes' before moving on.
steps: Prompt editor and empty meeting select
steal: The screen puts the plain-language instructions on the left and 'select meetings to preview / refine from output' on the right (screen 1).
'Preview Notes' stays disabled until at least two meetings are chosen, which forces a trial run (screens 1 to 4).
'Preview Notes' comes before 'Next', so a person checks the output before finishing setup (screen 4).
avoid: The flow never shows step 2 or a share or publish screen, so it is weak evidence for approving before learners see anything. It only covers previewing during setup.
mobbin:cc79d322-0fc9-4e2e-ac99-94fc9bee9.fit: Debrief and review: faculty could set what the AI should pull out of sim recordings and preview it on past sessions before it runs on live debriefs.

mobbin:e91b3485-47e0-458f-a4d9-a934d59e6.summary: The user opens a meeting, reads the general summary and notes with time links, searches the speaker-labelled transcript or asks AskFred, and controls playback (speed, 10-second skips, download, Share).
steps: Summary and Notes with timed link and transcript
Summary bullets, Notes heading and AskFred tab
steal: AI notes contain blue time links (for example 06:33) that jump from a claim to that moment in the recording (screen 1).
AskFred, a tab next to Transcript, keeps questions about the recording beside the searchable transcript (screens 1 to 3).
One bar at the bottom holds 1x speed, 10-second skips, Download and thumbs up or down on the AI output (screen 1).
avoid: Share is available as soon as the AI summary appears, with no edit or approve step before sharing. That goes against the human review in the baseline.
mobbin:e91b3485-47e0-458f-a4d9-a934d59e6.fit: Debrief and review: the closest Fireflies match to the SRV's summary, transcript and playback. Use it for AI debrief text linked to evidence, but add a faculty approval before learners can see it.

mobbin:0384c559-2a2e-4a37-9cb8-7be772d37.summary: From the clips panel, the user drags across a range to make a soundbite while the transcript highlights it. They then name the clip, pick a playlist and who can access it, and tap Done.
steps: Clips panel: Create or AI Soundbite
Create dialog: Drag and Select defaults
Range set with transcript range highlighted
Soundbite created: title and who can access
steal: 'Create Soundbite' (by hand) and 'AI Soundbite' sit side by side (screen 1).
Dragging across the recording, with START and END fields, colours the chosen part of the transcript purple so it can be checked before creating (screens 2 to 3).
Tabs for 'Magic Soundbite' and 'Keyword Soundbite' offer other ways to make clips without leaving the window (screen 2).
After creating, the window asks for a title and 'Who can access' (Participants only) before Done, so a person finishes the clip (screen 4).
mobbin:0384c559-2a2e-4a37-9cb8-7be772d37.fit: Debrief and review: a strong model for human review of AI clips before publishing. Trim against the transcript, publish with permissions, and attach the clip once faculty tap Done.
